title: Request FIELD_VALUES result format for targeted registry searches
answers: How do I query unified storage search for just one or two fields efficiently?
Why does a ResourceSearchRequest return RESOURCE_TABLE columns instead of typed fields?
How to avoid pulling default search fields when only checking hit count or one field?
body:
Symptom: registry code manually indexed `Results.Columns`/`Results.Rows` by column name (e.g. 'folder') to pull search results, which is brittle and pulls default fields even when only one field or just the hit count is needed.
Root cause: ResourceSearchRequest defaulted to RESOURCE_TABLE format; consumers had to find column indexes themselves (pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/search.go:getDashboardsUIDsSharedWithUser, pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/register.go:validateLibraryPanelDelete).
Fix pattern: set `ResultFormat: resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest_FIELD_VALUES` and an explicit `Fields` list (e.g. `[]string{resource.SEARCH_FIELD_FOLDER}` or just `resource.SEARCH_FIELD_NAME}` when only `TotalHits` matters), then parse the response with `dashboardsearch.ParseResults(resp, 0)` and read typed `Hits[i].Folder`/`.Name` instead of cell indexing.
Constraints: apply when a caller only needs a known, small set of fields from a dashboard/folder registry search; when only the hit count is needed, request the minimal Fields set to skip default-field cost; this is specific to ResourceSearchRequest/dashboard registry searches, not generic storage queries.
applies: pkg/registry/apis/dashboard registry search call sites building ResourceSearchRequest
says: Why does resource search return all columns when I need just one?
How to efficiently check a single field without pulling default columns?
Registry searches should avoid fetching columns you don't actually use
Is there a way to verify hit count without loading all fields?
How to request only the specific fields needed instead of all defaults?
search: Registry code performing targeted dashboard/folder searches should request ResultFormat: FIELD_VALUES with an explicit, narrowed Fields list instead of defaulting to RESOURCE_TABLE format, which requires brittle manual indexing of Results.Columns/Results.Rows by column name and fetches unnecessary default fields. Set Fields to only the needed columns (e.g. []string{resource.SEARCH_FIELD_FOLDER} or just resource.SEARCH_FIELD_NAME when only TotalHits is needed) and parse results with dashboardsearch.ParseResults(resp, 0) to access typed fields like Hits[i].Folder/.Name directly instead of cell indexing. This pattern eliminates manual column lookup and reduces cost by skipping default-field computation. Applies to ResourceSearchRequest call sites in pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/search.go and pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/register.go when building targeted dashboard/folder searches; not applicable to generic storage queries.
